title: J061 UPS and Battery Maintenance and Testing – Nashville VA Medical Center
agency: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF > VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF > 249-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 9 (36C249)
description:
The Department of Veterans Affairs, Network Contracting Office 9, seeks capable sources for preventive and corrective maintenance and testing of existing Eaton 9390 uninterruptible power supply (UPS) equipment and sealed VRLA batteries at the Nashville VA Medical Center, 1310 24th Avenue South, Nashville, TN 37212. 

 The anticipated one-year scope includes one pre-site survey, one UPS preventive maintenance visit, three battery preventive maintenance visits, one load-bank test, 24/7 support, and an eight-hour on-site emergency response. The contractor will provide a written report documenting test results, deficiencies, and recommended corrective actions. 

 Interested firms should email  shania.kimbrough@va.gov  by  November 24, 2026, at noon Central Time , using the subject line  Sources Sought – Nashville UPS and Battery Maintenance . Please include: 

 
	 
	 Company name, UEI, and point of contact. 
	 
	 
	 Business size under NAICS 811210 and any applicable SBA certifications, including SDVOSB or VOSB. 
	 
	 
	 Relevant Eaton 9390 experience, technician qualifications, and ability to meet the eight-hour on-site response requirement. 
	 
	 
	 Whether your firm would submit a quote if solicited. If applicable, include your GSA Schedule contract number and SIN and identify any work outside your Schedule. 
	 
 

 This notice is for market research only. It is not a solicitation or a commitment to award. No pricing is requested. No set-aside decision has been made.
